+title: Second pin move to alpha.7 and the client models, with the ACP adapter moved onto ConnectionModel
+---
+## What
+Move the pins to FoundationModelsACP `27419fa` or later (alpha.7, `updates(for:)` removed) and FoundationModelsACPClient `a65af8a` or later (`ConnectionModel`, `SessionModel`; `ACPSessionState`, `SwiftUIACPClient` and the old `SessionEntry` removed). Source: update.md §4.1, §7 item 3, §11 steps 6 and 7.
+
+**Start only when `a65af8a` is pushed to the remote `main` of FoundationModelsACPClient.** The build must stay green in this task, so it is a bridge: the views still bind to `AgentThread`. The later view tasks remove the bridge.
+
+- [ ] Read the real API of `ConnectionModel`, `SessionModel` and `TranscriptEntry` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/`). Correct update.md §4.2 and §4.3 where the names differ. Known differences: the open set is `openSessions`; `connect(over:logger:bufferLimits:client:)`; the model has `CompactionEntry`, `ErrorEntry`, `SessionNotice` and `updateTap()`.
+- [ ] Move the pins in the three `Package.resolved` files (root, `Benchmarks/`, the demo Xcode project). Pin each package to its revision; do not run a plain `swift package update`.
+- [ ] Change `ACPThreadSource` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/ACP/ACPThreadSource.swift`): open sessions with `ConnectionModel.newSession(_:)` and `resumeSession(_:)` (pass `replayFrom: .start` on resume). Feed `SessionUpdateMapping` from `SessionModel.updateTap()`. After the factory returns, seed the thread from the model state (`availableCommands`, `configOptions`, the transcript entries that arrived before the tap). Read the pending requests from `SessionModel.pendingPermissions` and `pendingElicitations`, and reply with their methods in `ACPThreadActions`.
+- [ ] Change `ACPSessionList` to `ConnectionModel.sessions`, `refreshSessions(cwd:)`, `loadMoreSessions()` and `hasMoreSessions`. Change `Sources/DemoSupport/ACPDemoSession.swift` and `Examples/ReadmeSnippets/Snippets/ACPQuickStart.swift` to `ConnectionModel` (no `updates(for:)`, no `SwiftUIACPClient`).
+- [ ] Change the ACP tests (`ACPThreadSourceTests`, `ACPThreadActionsTests`, `ACPSessionListTests`, `ProtocolVersionTests`, `ACPDemoSessionTests`) for the new API.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The three `Package.resolved` files pin the new revisions, and `ResolvedPinsTests` passes.
+- [ ] No source uses `ACPSessionState`, `SwiftUIACPClient` or `updates(for:)`.
+- [ ] A resume shows the replayed history in the thread.
+- [ ] `swift test`, `Scripts/check-readme.sh`, `Scripts/check-benchmarks.sh` and `Scripts/test-examples.sh AgentViewKitDemo` pass.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `ACPThreadSourceTests`: with `ScriptedWireAgent`, a prompt shows the user message and the agent message (the agent sends `messageId`); a resume with history shows the replayed entries.
+- [ ] Add `ACPSessionList` tests against `ConnectionModel` with two pages.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
